4: And one should juxtapose redemption to prayer without interrupting between them at all, as R' Yosef ben Elyakim testified, etc., in the first chapter of Berakhot (9b). And it was explained in Section 58 that the protection from harm for the entire day applies when one recites the Shema shortly before sunrise, so as to complete it and its blessings like the vatikin (diligent ones) at sunrise, and immediately juxtapose the prayer to it at sunrise. All the laws of juxtaposing redemption to prayer were explained in Siman 66.
